docs.title: Welcome to My Portfolio
docs.text: Hi, I'm James Singhi — a developing Software Engineer and Financial Analyst. This website aims to showcase my programming skills as well as my career portfolio, including projects across engineering and finance. Explore my work, projects, and professional journey.

System Architecture Inputs → Execution Layer → Outputs A rules-based discretionary workflow designed for repeatable execution. Inputs
  • Market structure
  • Reclaim signals
  • Volume confirmation
  • Catalyst events
Execution Layer
  • Limit orders only
  • Fee-aware target calculation
  • Defined invalidation
  • No leverage exposure
Outputs
  • 100% profitable trades recorded
  • 4–5% average net return per trade
  • 7-day avg holding
  • 77.8% capital efficiency
